title: Apply for a scrap metal exemption authority
summary: Tow truck operators using only crane-type tow trucks and carrying scrap metal directly to a recycling facility can apply for a scrap metal exemption certificate.
intro:
If you're a tow truck operator using only crane-type tow trucks and only carrying scrap metal directly to a scrap metal recycling facility, you can apply for a scrap metal exemption certificate.

There is a fee attached to this transaction.
who_can_apply: You must show that you are fit and proper to be granted the exemption certificate.
All trucks must be registered in the applicant's name.
The trucks must be solely used for transporting motor vehicles for scrap metal recycling.
The tow trucks must be crane-type (tip tray tow trucks are not eligible).
what_you_need: Photo IDs (back and front of driver licence, passport) of:
Latest annual company statement/extract with shareholder and director details (if applicable)
Certificate of currency for public liability insurance for your place of business
Current Transport for NSW certificates of registration for each vehicle operating
Clear colour photographs of the vehicles showing registration number and crane
A National Police Check (no more than 6 weeks old) for anyone nominated on the form who has lived overseas or in another Australian state or territory in the last 10 years
Printout of interstate/overseas criminal record(s) (if applicable)
Details of all employed/engaged tow truck drivers
A credit card or PayPal account for your payment
The PDF form – 'Application for Scrap Metal Exemption Certificate'.
Your business details, and copy(ies) of:

how_to_steps.text: Ensure you and all directors, partners and close associates sign the declaration.
Make your payment with credit card or PayPal, via the link on the form.
Gather all the required supporting documentation.
Lodge your application using the details on the form.

more_info.text: As part of the assessment process, NSW Fair Trading will check whether an applicant has a criminal record.
Tow trucks transporting motor vehicles destined for repair, reuse or resale in their original form or as parts, cannot be included on an exemption certificate.
Your tow trucks must have an approved sign displayed on the front and rear of each tow truck in positions where they are visible outside the tow truck.

faqs.q: What type of tow truck is eligible for this certificate?
faqs.a: You must use crane-type tow trucks. Tip tray tow trucks are not eligible.

faqs.q: Must the tow trucks be registered in my name?
faqs.a: Yes, all trucks must be registered in the applicant's name. Lease agreements are not accepted.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of the scrap metal exemption certificate?
faqs.a: It allows tow truck operators who use only crane-type tow trucks and only carry scrap metal directly to a scrap metal recycling facility to operate.
